design: Three leave-one-environment-out folds. Target environment entirely excluded. Source participants disjoint across training/validation/familiar test. Target labels used only for evaluation.
selection_rule: SHA256-ranked subject roles within environment and six trial IDs per subject/experiment; same trial IDs for related segments. No outcome inspection.
scope: Joint environment and participant-cohort transfer. Distinct participants per environment confound pure room effects. Seven selected activity segments; not the complete dataset benchmark.

planned_corruption.unit: masked normalized-time positions after resampling; common to all channels; linear interpolation with held endpoints
